findings.desc: CHK-001:edge:0 idempotency path untested — smoke only proves different payloads produce different digests; the artifact-store writeArtifact early-return (existsSync check at artifact-store.ts:106-108) is never exercised. The intent requires proof that same payload written twice returns the same artifact without mutation, but no assertion calls createProbe (or any writer) twice with identical input.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by commit 576b2c62e: repro-first smoke now calls createProbe twice with the identical canonical subject and asserts same artifactDigest and same artifactId, exercising the artifact-store early-return idempotency path. Verified with npm --prefix packages/main run build and npm --prefix packages/main run test:repro-first-candidate.

findings.desc: CHK-002:edge:0 empty-pattern fail-closed path untested — evaluateRedGreenRelation checks !baselineExpectedFailurePattern || !currentExpectedFailurePattern (repro-intake.ts:318-321) to fail closed on empty patterns, but the smoke step-10 mismatch test uses non-empty patterns (pattern-a / pattern-b). The empty-pattern code path is never triggered, leaving the fail-closed guarantee for that condition unverified.

Verified with npm --prefix packages/main run build and npm --prefix packages/main run test:repro-first-candidate.

findings.desc: Probe Contract table in repro-first-story-intake-experiment.md omits two optional fields that exist in ReproProbePayload and affect the artifact digest when supplied: `baselineHeadHash?` and `materialHash?`. Both are present in core/repro-intake.ts (CreateProbeInput), handlers/repro-intake.ts (ReproProbeArgs), and core/evidence/types.ts (ReproProbePayload). The table presents itself as comprehensive (| Field | Meaning |) but omits these two optional fields entirely, so a caller reading only the docs would not know these fields exist or that they are included in the digest canonical subject.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by commit 1c1ce4724: Probe Contract now documents optional baselineHeadHash and materialHash fields, matching ReproProbePayload/CreateProbeInput/ReproProbeArgs. This is a docs-only correction to keep caller-facing contract aligned with implemented digest subject.

findings.desc: Maintainability/integrity: the canonical digest subject is constructed in two independent places in artifact-store.ts — digestSubject() (lines 75-84, write path, keys: artifactKind/schemaVersion/producer(opts.producer ?? 'repro-intake')/evidenceScope/subjectBinding/payload) and verifyArtifactDigest() (lines 155-162, verify path, same 6 keys reconstructed from a stored EvidenceArtifact). They are currently field-for-field identical, but there is no shared source of truth, so any future change to the digest subject (e.g. adding a field on the write side) must be mirrored by hand in the verify side or every verifyArtifactDigest() call silently returns false (digest mismatch / false tamper-detection). This is the exact multi-read-point hazard CLAUDE.md's integrity conventions warn about, in code whose whole purpose is tamper detection. Suggest a single helper that takes the 6 canonical fields and is called by both write and verify (write maps CreateArtifactOptions→fields applying the producer default; verify maps the stored artifact→fields). Not a current correctness bug (build clean, smoke green); low-severity preventive refactor.
